latin: Siqua est natura immediata nobis quae sit uel simpliciter_uel saltem ut multum rationaliter rationalis, magicam habet in summo, et eius participatione potest in hominibus esse perfectior.
latin_note: OCR text runs 'simpliciter_uel' together for 'simpliciter vel' (farmer1998:25283).
translation: If there is any nature immediate to us that is either simply rational, or at least so in a highly rational way, it possesses magic in the highest degree, and by participation in it, magic can become more perfect in men.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch8, from Latin at farmer1998:25283
